## Checks
- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm test` pass
- [ ] Demo flows unaffected (or changed on purpose, described above)
- [ ] New block/action/component has spec, native twin, tests, docs
- [ ] No secrets, personal data or floats for money
- [ ] Nothing published; no Claude Code settings changed
- [ ] Only the files for this change are staged

## Security notes
Does this touch sign-in, sessions, journey delivery, adapters, storage or the AI layer? If yes, say how it is covered in `docs/SECURITY.md`.
